q: Augustine yazaalibwa ddi era wa, era amaka ge gaali gatya?
a: Aurelius Augustinus yazaalibwa nga 13 Novemba 354 mu Thagaste, akabuga akatono ak'omunda mu Afirika ey'Obukiikakkono ey'Abaruumi, mu ekyo kaakano ekiyitibwa Algeria. Kitaawe, Patricius, yali nnannyini ttaka ow'ekigero era omukaafiiri ow'obusungu obw'amangu eyabatizibwa okumpi n'enkomerero y'obulamu bwe. Nnyina, Monica, yali Mukristaayo ow'okukkiriza okukakanyavu era okukaaba, era okusaba kwe, okusinga omusomesa yenna, kwe kukola olugero lw'omwana we. Nga beegomba ebirabo by'omulenzi, bazadde be baakuŋŋaanya ssente okumusomesa ewala n'awaka, okusooka e Madauros n'oluvannyuma, ng'alina emyaka kkumi na musanvu, e Carthage.

q: Olugero lw'emipeeri egyabbibwa lwali lutya, era lwaki Augustine yalutwala nga lukulu nnyo?
a: Mu Ebyokwatula Augustine alwawo ku kiro ky'obwana mwe ye n'ekibinja ky'emikwano gye baanyagira omuti gw'emipeeri ogwa muliraanwa ne basuula ebibala eri embizzi. Yalina emipeeri emirungi okusingawo ewaka era teyagyagala n'akatono; era yalaba nti ekyo kye kyali ensonga yennyini. "Nnayagala ekibi kyange kyennyini," bwe yawandiika, "si ekyo kye nnakola ekibi, wabula ekibi kyennyini." Obubbi obutono bwafuuka gy'ali eddirisa eritunuulira ekyama kyonna eky'ekibi — omutima ogusanyukira ekikugirwa olw'ensonga nti kikugirwa kyokka.

q: Omukazi Augustine gwe yabeera naye yali ani, era Adeodatus yali ani?
a: Ng'akyali muvubuka mu Carthage, Augustine yatwala omukazi mu nnyumba ye — talinnya erinnya lye mu Ebyokwatula — n'abeera naye mu bwesigwa, nga tebafumbiriganwa, okumala emyaka egisukka ennyo mu kkumi. Yamuzaalira omwana ow'obulenzi gwe yatuuma Adeodatus, "eyaweebwa Katonda", erinnya ery'ekisa eky'ekitalo okuva ku musajja eyali adduka n'amaanyi ge gonna okuva ku Muwi. Augustine anyumya ebyafaayo bino awatali kwekwasa oba kwewolereza, era obwesigwa bwe ku bino kitundu ku ekyo ekifuula Ebyokwatula okuba eby'okwesigwa ennyo. Emyaka bwe gyayitawo mu Milan, nnyina bwe yateekateeka obufumbo obw'ekitiibwa, omukazi yazzibwayo mu Afirika — "ng'asikuliddwa ku lubuto lwange," bwe yawandiika, "omutima gwange ogwali gumunyweredde gwayuzibwa ne gufumitibwa ne guvaamu omusaayi" — era n'alayira obutamanya musajja mulala. Augustine, ng'atasobola kulinda omugole we atuuke mu myaka, amangu ago n'atwala omulala, era n'ekyo akiwandiika n'ensonyi so si ng'akyewolereza.

q: Kiki ekyasika Augustine eri Abamanike, era yakolanga mulimu ki?
a: Mu mwaka gwe ogw'ekkumi n'omwenda, okusoma Hortensius ya Cicero kwamuleetera okwegomba okugezi, naye n'asanga Olulattini lw'Ebyawandiikibwa nga lubi n'akyukira Abamanike, ekibinja ekikakanyavu eky'endowooza y'okubaawo kubiri ekyawendelezaamu obwongo bwe nga kimusuubiza okumanya awatali kwetoowaza kwa kukkiriza, era ekyateeka mu ngeri emunyangu ensibuko y'ekibi ebweru w'okwagala kwe. Yasigala mu "abawuliriza" baabwe okumala emyaka nga mwenda. Ekiseera ekyo kyonna yeeyimirizangawo n'okusomesa okwogera obulungi, ng'asomesa mu Carthage, oluvannyuma e Rome, era mu 384 n'afuna ekifo eky'ekitiibwa eky'okusomesa okwogera obulungi mu Milan, entebe y'olukiiko lwa kabaka. Yali alinnye kumpi waggulu nga bwe kisoboka okusukkuluma okutwala omulenzi ow'oku byalo, naye yali tannabeera na nnaku nnyingi bw'etyo. Okusuulibwa essuubi kwe mu Bamanike kweyongera omusomesa waabwe ow'ettutumu Faustus bwe yalabika ng'ow'ebigambo ebirungi naye nga wa bwereere bwe yabuuzibwa ebibuuzo.

q: Okusaba kwa Monica kwamugoberera kutya mu myaka egyo?
a: Augustine agamba nti nnyina yamukaabira okusinga bannyina bwe bakaabira okufa kw'emibiri gy'abaana baabwe, kubanga yasobola okulaba okufa kwe yali afa mu butuufu. Amaziga ge, bwe yawandiika, "gaafukirira ettaka wansi w'amaaso ge mu buli kifo mwe yasabiranga." Yatawaanya omulabirizi, ye yennyini eyali Omumanike edda, okuwakana n'omwana we omugezi eyali yonooneddwa, okutuusa ku nkomerero, ng'akooye olwe, n'amusindika ng'amuwa ekigambo kye yatwala ng'ekivudde mu ggulu: "tekisoboka omwana w'amaziga gano okuzikirira." Augustine bwe yasaabala okugenda e Rome, yamulimba n'agenda ekiro ng'ali mu kusaba, naye ku nkomerero n'amugoberera okutuuka e Milan.

q: Ambrose ow'e Milan yakola ki mu kukyuka kwe?
a: Mu Milan ebintu bibiri byatandika mu kasirise okukola ku Augustine. Ekisooka kwali Ambrose, omulabirizi w'ekibuga ow'amaanyi, eyayaniriza omusomesa omuvubuka n'ekisa. Augustine yajja olw'engeri y'okwogera n'asigala olw'ekigambo kyennyini: Ambrose yannyonnyola Endagaano Enkadde mu ngeri eyamulaga nti Ebyawandiikibwa bye yali anyoomye byali bya buziba, so si bya bumpi, okusinga Cicero. Ekyokubiri kwali ebitabo bitono ebya Baplatoni, ebyamenya obulogo bw'Abamanike nga bimuyigiriza okutegeera Katonda n'emmeeme ng'ebintu eby'omwoyo mu kifo ky'ekintu eky'omubiri ekitali kya bulambulukufu. Obwongo bwe bwatambula; okwagala kwe tekwatambula, era n'asaba okusaba kwe yajjukira oluvannyuma n'ensonyi: "Mpa obulongoofu n'okwegendereza, naye si kaakano."

q: Kiki ekyabaawo mu nnimiro e Milan mu 386?
a: Ku nkomerero y'ebbugumu mu 386, bwe yawulira ku balala abaali baleseewo buli kimu, Augustine yasuulibwa mu kibuyaga eky'okwekyawa. N'addukira mu nnimiro y'ennyumba gye yali agabana ne mukwano gwe Alypius, n'asuula omubiri gwe wansi w'omutiini, n'akaaba, nga yeebuuza okutuusa ddi lw'anaagenda mu maaso ng'agamba nti "enkya, era enkya." Awo, okuva mu nnyumba eriraanye, n'awulira eddoboozi ly'omwana nga liyimba akayimba akatono emirundi n'emirundi — "Tolle, lege; tolle, lege," ddira osome — ebigambo bye yali tasobola kugeraageranya na muzannyo gwonna ogw'abaana. N'addayo ku kitabo ky'ebbaluwa za Pawulo, n'akiggula, n'asoma ekitundu ekisooka amaaso ge kye gaagwako, okuva mu Abaruumi 13: si mu binyumu na mu butamiivu, si mu bwenzi na mu buwemu, naye "Twambale Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo, so temuteekerateekera mubiri kwegomba kwagwo." Teyasoma na kalala. "Amangu ago," bwe yawandiika, "ekizikiza kyonna eky'okubuusabuusa ne kibula."

q: Kiki ekyaddirira ku kubatizibwa kwa Augustine, ku nnyina, ne ku mwana we?
a: Yeeggyako ekifo kye eky'okusomesa, n'asenguka mu ttoggo eryo okugenda mu nnyumba ey'oku byalo e Cassiciacum, era ku kiseera kya Pasika mu 387 n'abatizibwa Ambrose, awamu ne Alypius era ne mutabani we Adeodatus, eyali tannaweza myaka kkumi n'etaano era ng'obugezi bwe bwatiisa kitaawe. Ku lugendo oluddayo eka, ku mwalo gw'e Ostia, nnyina n'omwana ne beesigamira ku ddirisa ne boogera nga bagenda waggulu okutuuka ku Magezi mu ago ebintu byonna mwe bikolerwa; ennaku ntono oluvannyuma Monica n'akwatibwa omusujja n'afa, ng'ali mu mwaka gwe ogw'amakumi ataano mu mukaaga ate ye mu gwe ogw'amakumi asatu mu esatu. Bwe yabuuzibwa gy'anaaziikibwa, yagamba bugambi nti: "munanjjukiranga ku kyoto kya Mukama, buli gye munaabanga." Mu myaka ebiri oba esatu Adeodatus naye yafa, ng'akyali mu myaka gy'obuvubuka.

q: Augustine yafuuka atya omulabirizi w'e Hippo, era yawandiika ki?
a: Bwe yadda mu Afirika yatunda obusika bwe n'akuŋŋaanya ekibiina ekitono ekyabeera mu kusaba, mu kusoma ne mu bwavu obugabanyizibwa. Teyayagala kintu kya lwatu, naye mu 391, ng'akyalidde ekibuga ky'omwalo Hippo Regius, ekibiina kyamukaka okuyawulibwa, era nga mu 395 n'afuuka omulabirizi w'e Hippo, ekifo kye yakwata okumala emyaka nga amakumi asatu mu etaano. Okuva mu kibuga ekyo eky'omwalo ekitali kya kyewuunyo yabuuliranga obutakoma, yatereezanga emisango wakati wa baliraanwa, era yawandiikanga ebbaluwa okwetooloola obwakabaka. Nga mu 397 yatandika Ebyokwatula, ebitawandiikirwa musomi wabula Katonda; oluvannyuma lw'Abagooti okunyaga Rome mu 410 yakolerera okusukka mu myaka kkumi ku Ekibuga kya Katonda, ng'anoonyereza ebyafaayo byonna ng'olugero lw'ebibuga bibiri ebyazimbibwa okwagala kubiri. Era yawakana n'Abadonati, ng'akakasa nti Ekkanisa mu nsi eno nnimiro egattiddwa ey'eŋŋaano n'omuddo, era ne Pelagius, ng'anyweza — ng'ava mu kujjukira okwagala kwe okwali kwakoowa — nti buli kimu kitandikira ku kisa.

Emyaka gye egy'enkomerero gyayonoona. Mu 429 Abavandali baasomoka ne bayingira mu Afirika ey'Obukiikakkono, era mu 430 ne bazingiza Hippo yennyini. Augustine, mu mwaka gwe ogw'amakumi musanvu mu mukaaga, n'akyakola era n'akyasaba ng'omulabe atudde ebweru wa bbugwe, ng'asaba Katonda oba okuwonya ekibuga oba okufuula abaweereza be abavumu okugumiikiriza okwagala kwe, "oba waakiri anziggye mu nsi eno anzitwale gy'ali." Mu mwezi ogw'okusatu ogw'okuzingizibwa n'akwatibwa omusujja; yasaba Zabbuli ez'okwenenya ziwandiikibwe ziwanikibwe gy'ayinza okuzisomera ng'ali ku kitanda kye, era n'azikaabira n'eddembe — omuyigiriza omukulu ow'ekisa ng'afa ng'omwenenya. Yafa nga 28 Agusito 430, Abavandali nga bakyali ku miryango, nga talese kiraamo, kubanga, nga omuwandiisi w'ebyafaayo bye Possidius bwe yagamba, ng'omuntu omwavu owa Katonda teyalina ky'aleka okuggyako abakulembeze b'ekkanisa ye n'etterekero lye ery'ebitabo, bye baakuuma.
